ERR_NO_REFERENCE.TITLE: Error: No reference found (%e)
ERR_NO_REFERENCE.EXPL: The executable wasn't called with a valid or no reference argument (Arguments: %s).
ERR_NO_REFERENCE.REASON: This could be due to an error while the installation process.
ERR_NO_REFERENCE.FIX: Try uninstalling the programm via the 'uninstall.exe' in the programm folder, and then reinstalling it.

ERR_INVALID_FILE.TITLE: Error: Invalid file type (%e)
ERR_INVALID_FILE.EXPL: The requested file type (%s) cannot be opened via this programm.
ERR_INVALID_FILE.REASON: When this happened automatically, there is something incorrectly configured with this file type.
ERR_INVALID_FILE.FIX: Try right-clicking the file, and then choosing 'Open with' from the dropdown. Here select the programm you want this filetype to be opened with.
